lastCompletedStory.title: Pure graph helpers: isBlocked, deriveBlocks, referential-integrity check

nextStoryContext: US-002 is complete. src/issues/graph.ts provides three pure functions: isBlocked (returns true when any present, non-shipped dep blocks), deriveBlocks (reverse index Map), and checkReferentialIntegrity (flags missing-id refs and self-refs). All are I/O-free and import only from src/issues/types.ts. US-003 (selectPlannableIssue) imports isBlocked from graph.ts and IssueEntry from types.ts. The test mirror is test/issues/graph.test.ts (18 tests, 0 fail). knip.json still ignores src/issues/types.ts (the entry is a no-op now that graph.ts imports it, but harmless; leave it until a later story cleans up). Do NOT implement Kahn topo-sort, cycle rejection, or escalation in US-003 (those are Epico C, out of scope). US-003 notes warn about the coverage ratchet: keep selectPlannableFromFile thin to preserve the aggregate coverage floor.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure graph helpers story: only TypeScript logic importing from the project's own types.ts. No external library API was exercised.
